swap.evidence: Products imagined: a council vaccination-clinic booking and a leisure-centre swim-session booking. Surviving unchanged: day buttons, 96px slot grid with 'Few left'/'Full' tags, single-column form, bordered white cards, dark-green filled button, bin glyph would just change. Bound to this product: only the copy (gate, vehicle, DRC- permit, rubble and mattress limits, DR- reference). With the name hidden the visuals do not say 'recycling centre'; only the words do.

category_guess.evidence: Predicted default for a UK council booking flow: pale ground, one system-like sans, one civic green, bordered white cards, red-bordered error summary, text step indicator, no imagery. Predicted opposite: a bright consumer-app booking with rounded cards and illustration. Every identity-carrying element (ground, green, single face, borders, error summary) matches the default.

similar_prompt.evidence: Similar brief: 'booking flow for a council's bulky-waste home collection, residents on phones'. Predicted: the same day chips, slot grid with availability tags, one green, one sans, white bordered cards, a large reference on the done page. Overlap is near total; only copy differs.

attributes.pair: firm about the rules, not stern

mode_fit: All four surfaces are Operate/Read and stay conventional in structure, which is correct. No hero moments, no motion beyond feedback. The problem is not excess expression but the absence of an identity floor (ADR-035).

specificity.label: (judged)

detector_comparison.post_unseal_notes: Detectors reported no hits; nothing changes the verdicts.

findings.title: Cancelled booking page still headed 'Booked' and tells the resident to show the reference at the gate
findings.description: On /done.html with status=cancelled the H1 remains 'Booked', and below a red 'Status: cancelled. This booking is not on the gate's list.' the card still says 'Show this at the gate, on your phone or on paper...' and 'A reminder will be sent to your mobile the evening before.' The 'At the centre' card is unchanged.
findings.impact: The page contradicts itself; a resident glancing at the large 'Booked' heading and reference may be likely to drive to the centre and be turned away.

harm.statement: A resident whose booking was cancelled may read 'Booked' and 'Show this at the gate' and take the booking as valid, arriving with a loaded car and being turned away.

evidence.detail: H1 'Booked'; red status line followed by 'Show this at the gate' and reminder text

findings.recommendation: Decide a distinct cancelled state: the heading and instructions should state the booking is not valid and what to do instead.

findings.title: Reference card on the done page omits the day, slot time and vehicle
findings.description: The 'Your reference' card shows DR-204117 and instructions but not Saturday 17 October, 09:20 to 09:40, or Car / garden waste. The surface's job is 'know the booking is made and what to show at the gate', and the attendant checks the vehicle against the booking.
findings.impact: Residents keep this page (or a screenshot) to read at a gate with poor signal; without the time on it they may be likely to arrive in the wrong slot.

harm.statement: A resident checking the done page or a screenshot of it the next morning cannot see when the slot is or which vehicle was booked, so may be likely to arrive at the wrong time or with the wrong vehicle.

evidence.detail: Reference card: 'Your reference / DR-204117 / Show this at the gate...'; no date, time or vehicle anywhere on the page

findings.recommendation: Decide what the gate and the resident need to read together and place it in the reference card.

findings.title: 'Few left' slots pulled out of time order into an unlabelled group above 'Morning'
findings.description: On the When step, every slot with few places left is listed first, under no heading, before 'Morning' and 'Afternoon'. On Saturday 17 the Morning group then shows only 08:00, 09:20, 10:00, 11:00-11:40, while 08:20, 08:40, 09:00, 09:40, 10:20, 10:40 sit above with afternoon slots 13:40-16:40 mixed in.
findings.impact: Residents scan for a time ('Saturday morning'); splitting the timeline makes the morning look nearly full and forces a second scan.

harm.statement: A resident looking for a Saturday morning slot may read the 'Morning' group as the whole morning and think 08:20-10:40 are unavailable, or pick a later day than needed.

evidence.detail: Ten 'Few left' slots in an unheaded block above 'Morning'

findings.recommendation: Decide whether scarcity or time is the sort key; residents' words ('Saturday morning') suggest time, with scarcity shown in place.

findings.title: Expired hold leaves the slot as '–' while 'Book this slot' stays the only filled action
findings.description: On confirm with an expired hold the error summary says 'This slot is no longer available.' with no link, the summary row reads 'Slot – · Change slot', and the filled 'Book this slot' button remains the primary action at the bottom.
findings.impact: The page's primary action is one that cannot succeed; the recovery ('Change slot') is a small inline link.

harm.statement: A resident whose hold expired may press 'Book this slot' again rather than find the small 'Change slot' link, slowing rebooking of the slot they need.

evidence.detail: 'There is a problem / This slot is no longer available.'; 'Slot – · Change slot'; 'Book this slot' filled

findings.recommendation: Decide which action is primary when the hold has gone, and make the error summary lead to it.

findings.title: Permit number field shown when no vehicle, or a car, is chosen
findings.description: In the vehicle errors state no vehicle is selected, yet 'Permit number / Starts DRC-, then five digits.' and its input sit directly under the vehicle buttons, between the vehicle error and the waste question.
findings.impact: Most residents bring a car and do not need a permit; an always-visible permit field suggests they do.

harm.statement: A resident with a car may take the permit field as required for them and stop to look for a permit they do not need.

evidence.detail: No vehicle selected; Permit number field visible

findings.recommendation: Decide whether the permit field belongs only to the van and trailer choices; verify against the default and car states, which were not inspected here.

findings.title: Two day buttons look selected at once after choosing a slot
findings.description: In slot-chosen at 375 light both 'Tomorrow' and 'Saturday 17' carry the pale green selected tint; only Saturday 17 has the darker border. Slots shown are for Saturday 17 October.
findings.impact: The chosen day is the core fact of the step; an ambiguous selection may cause doubt about which day is being booked. May be a hover or focus residue from capture.

harm.statement: A resident may be unsure whether the slot grid shows tomorrow or Saturday, and could book the wrong day.

findings.recommendation: Decide that the selected tint is used for one state only, distinct from hover and focus.

findings.title: No identity beyond the council name; nothing from the centre's own world
findings.description: Every screen is a default council form: the masthead is the name in bold body text with a generic bin glyph, no imagery of Quarry Road or the gate, no device drawn from the vehicle classes, bays or the 20-minute slot. The done page, the one screen kept to show at the gate, sets the reference in plain bold with nothing to make it recognisable to an attendant at a glance.
findings.impact: Design note: the 'plain, not bare' attribute drifts to bare; the service reads as any council form.
findings.recommendation: Choose one signature from the centre's own mechanism (the gate check, the reference as a gate pass) and give the identity a floor on every surface, within the Operate mode.

findings.title: Desktop widths half empty: forms and slot grid stop short of the content width
findings.description: At 1280 and 1440 the slot grid ends at seven columns (~720px) while the Opening days card below spans ~1088px; vehicle and confirm forms occupy ~610px with the right half blank; the done page's footer ends mid-viewport leaving an empty grey band.
findings.impact: Design note: reads as unfinished at desktop; DESIGN.md says the slot grid 'fills the width from 96 px columns', which it does not at 1280/1440.
findings.recommendation: Decide the desktop composition deliberately: either the grid fills the declared width or the content width matches the column the forms use.

strengths: Rules stated beside the control they govern ('Rubble (up to four bags)', 'Starts DRC-, then five digits', the permit info panel), in a firm, unstern voice.
One filled button per step and a composed dark theme with lighter greens and cards lighter than the ground.
Error summary with linked messages and inline errors on the vehicle step.
keep: Keep the gate-attendant voice and the rule-beside-the-control pattern; any added identity must not displace them.
not_assessable: No baseline, so no pairwise comparison. Stills cannot show focus order, the 'Another day' picker, hold timing or motion. Vehicle default and car-selected states were not separately inspected for the permit field.
notes: Detector output was sealed until the verdict file existed; it contained 0 hits. anti-slop.md was not consulted. No source code, builder notes or other critics' files were read.
